remarks: Charming & Bright 1-Bedroom Condo with Private Entrance - Ideal Location!  Step into this beautifully refreshed one-bedroom condominium, offering both comfort and convenience. With its private entrance, this home provides the perfect blend of privacy and accessibility.  Features you'll love:  Freshly painted interiors and brand-new bedroom carpet, complementing the elegant hardwood floors in the living room and kitchen. A stylish, updated white kitchen, perfect for those who love to cook or entertain. Modern stone-tiled bathroom for a spa-like experience. Abundant natural light throughout, making every room feel bright and inviting. Generous closet space plus extra storage, giving you all the room you need to stay organized. Convenience at its best:  Walking distance to Metro-North, with quick access to Merritt Parkway-a commuter's dream! Close to shopping, dining, and entertainment-everything you need is right around the corner. Enjoy the large shared yard with picnic tables, perfect for relaxing or social gatherings. Free laundry facilities in the basement. Includes one reserved parking space. Important: Good credit is required.  This condo offers the best of both worlds-serenity and city convenience. Schedule your tour today and make this lovely home yours!
